data.body: SC3 ALIGNMENT: content_hash length aligned on 16 hex chars. The decision-id-format.md contract specifies 'first 16 hex characters' (implementation-correct). The epic SC3 text referencing '12 chars' was a transcription error during spec authoring. No code change required — all existing implementations (decision-id-format.md, inference-envelope.md, red-team-reviewer.md) consistently use 16 chars.
